run_versiongenerate: run versiongenerate.py with input_dir and output_dir arguments to extract version from configure.ac
extract_version_from_configure_ac: extract the major, minor, and fix version numbers from a configure.ac file using regex
generate_version_header: generate a Version.h header file with GTEST_VERSIONINFO_SHORT and GTEST_VERSIONINFO_LONG defines
parse_ac_init_macro: parse the AC_INIT macro in configure.ac to extract a three-part version string
review_versiongenerate_script: review the versiongenerate.py script that reads configure.ac and writes Version.h for gtest.framework
